intro: Pakistani culture blends Persian, Mughal, South Asian and regional traditions, from Sufi music to truck art.

chapters.title: Music and poetry
text: Qawwali is devotional Sufi music; Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan made it famous worldwide. Poetry matters deeply: Allama Iqbal, the national poet, is honoured on 9 November.
Coke Studio Pakistan mixes folk and pop and has huge audiences across South Asia.

chapters.title: Art and crafts
text: Trucks and buses are painted with bright flowers, birds and poems, a style known as truck art. Lahore's walled city and the shrines of Sufi saints are centres of culture.

chapters.title: Food
text: Biryani, nihari, karahi and kebabs are favourites, often eaten with naan or roti. Chai is drunk everywhere.

keyTerms.meaning: Sufi devotional singing, often lasting for hours.
